abstract.text:
Abstract—In this paper, a probabilistic static voltage stability 
assessment method is proposed to study the influence of correlated 
renewable energy and loads on static voltage stability of 
distribution network. Through non-parametric kernel density 
estimation, the probability distribution function of distributed 
renewable generation output power is obtained, and the joint 
probability distribution is established by Copula function. Based 
on the quasi-monte Carlo simulation, the samples of random input 
variables are gained, and then the distribution of load margin is 
calculated. The efficiency and accuracy of quasi-monte Carlo 
simulation is verified, and the impact of the correlation between 
distributed generation on the static voltage stability of distribution 
network is studied. Besides, the influence of distributed generation 
configuration on voltage stability is also discussed.

introduction.text:
I. INTRODUCTION 
Recently, the penetration rate of distributed generation (DG) 
in the distribution network has gradually increased, where the 
wind power and photovoltaic power generation are mainly 
used[1]. However, due to the uncertainties and correlations of the 
output of DG and loads, the static voltage stability of the 
distribution network will be affected [2]. Therefore, in order to 
guarantee the stable operation of distribution network, it is 
necessary to study the probabilistic static voltage stability 
assessment method of the distribution network considering the 
uncertainties and correlations. 
The static voltage stability analysis is based on the power 
flow equation. The load margin is obtained by calculating the 
critical point of the system static voltage stability. The common 
methods contain direct method, nonlinear programming method 
and continuous power flow method [3]. Further, considering the 
uncertainty in system, the scholars have proposed some 
probability assessment methods for static voltage stability. In 
[4], based on the point estimate method and the Cornish-Fisher 
series, a static voltage stability probability assessment method 
for the distribution network was proposed. In [3], through quasi-
monte Carlo (QMC) simulation, a probabilistic static voltage 
stability method was proposed and the influence of the 
stochastic factors such as wind power and loads on the voltage 
stability margin is studied. In [5], combining the analytical 
method and approximation method, a probability model 
considering the random characteristics of the DG output was 
established. However, in above literatures, the DG output is 
obtained according to the parametric model of random variables, 
such as the Weibull distribution of wind speed and the Beta 
distribution of solar radiation intensity. The stochastic 
distribution characteristics in some regions cannot be simply 
described by the parametric model. Therefore, it is necessary to 
apply the non-parametric estimation method to depict the 
probability distribution of the random variable. Kernel density 
estimation (KDE) is a non-parametric estimation method which 
can gain the probability distribution of random input variables[6]. 
Meanwhile, there is a certain correlation between the same type 
of DG and the load, and their influences on the static voltage 
stability of the distribution network cannot be ignored. 
In this paper, considering the uncertainties of DG output and 
loads, a probabilistic static voltage stability assessment method 
for distribution network is proposed. The probability 
distribution of DG output is generated by non-parametric KDE. 
The joint probability distribution between DGs with correlation 
is established by Copula function. Then, the samples of random 
input variables are obtained based on QMC simulation and the 
load margin is calculated by continuous power flow method. 
Through the simulation of IEEE 33-bus distribution network, the 
PDF of load margin is obtained. The efficiency and accuracy of 
QMC simulation are verified. Meanwhile, the effect of the 
correlation of DGs and loads on the static voltage stability is 
analyzed. The influence of DG configuration on improving 
voltage stability is further studied.

conclusion.text:
VII. CONCLUSION 
In this paper, considering the uncertainty and correlation of 
renewable energy and loads, a probabilistic static voltage 
stability assessment method for distribution network is proposed. 
The probability distribution of DG output power is obtained by 
non-parametric KDE method. Meanwhile, the Copula function 
is used to establish the joint probability distribution for the 
correlated DG output power. The samples of random input 
variables are obtained based on QMC simulation, and the load 
margin is calculated by continuous power flow. Through the 
simulation of the distribution network system, the main 
conclusions are given as follows: 
(1) The QMC simulation based on Sobol sequence can improve 
the calculation efficiency and guarantee accuracy of results. 
Compared with the SRS-based MCS, it is more suitable for 
the probabilistic static voltage stability assessment of the 
distribution network. 
(2) The correlation among DG and loads has a significant 
impact on the static voltage stability of the distribution 
network. 
(3) The reasonable configuration for DG units is beneficial to 
improve the static voltage stability of system.
